title: Presentations and components for raw scalar localization
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a noetherian finite-dimensional scheme $T$ on which $\ell$ is invertible. Use the integral and raw rational categories and scalar extensions of [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi, def-weil-pbc-rational-category, prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension, def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], with the integral and rational stage equivalences of [def-fd-coefficient-comparison-datum]. Write $U,C$ for completed and ordinary integral transitions, $S,P$ for the specified raw rational transitions, and $I,J$ for the supplied integral and rational identifications. A RationalFamily is the supplied family $J$ presented on the named framework stages, with HEq fixing both its functors and their shift isomorphisms. RawComparison is a family $j_{L/E}:S_{L/E}J_L\cong J_EP_{L/E}$. For a chain $E\subseteq L\subseteq M\subseteq N$, fourComparison is the three consecutive inverse comparisons, namely $j_{N/M}$ followed by $P_{N/M}(j_{M/L})$ and $P_{N/M}P_{M/L}(j_{L/E})$. leftContraction and rightContraction are the two composites of the framework associator along this chain. Integral associators and units include the actual coefficient inclusion equality transports. These are the same definitions formerly in the scalar coherence module, with all names, types, shifts and component formulas unchanged.
